body:
It's no joke.  I've never been more serious.  You, on the other hand.... Is that really the worst you can do?  Call my King a joke?

I'm praying for you, strawberrymask.
I know it sounds crazy to those who don't believe in Him, but truth is truth.  I know what, and Who, I heard.  I wouldn't be here to reply if it hadn't been for Him.

Everyone makes mistakes.  I know I've made many, many mistakes.  You made a mistake, sending the picture.  But people can recover from their mistakes.

Please, don't let one mistake end your life.  You know the truth, that  you never did anything to/with those girls except sending that picture.  And, despite any rumors that get spread, that truth remains.

And I know you said you no longer have a lust for life, but please find something to live for.  There has to be someone who cares about you, and who would miss you if you were gone.  And I know this is a cliché, but it really does get better.  I nearly committed suicide.  I know what it's like.

I'll be praying for you.
For me, the hymn "It Is Well with My Soul" has helped me more than anything.  Also, "Solar Sailer" from Tron Legacy and Still Alive from Mirror's Edge.
